title: Medtrum : PasswordReset doesn't work
symptom: After force closing AAPS and creating a PasswordReset file in aaps/extra, starting AAPS and entering the pump base serial in the config wizard results in a wrong password error. The file remains on dev but is deleted on master.
cause: The password reset file content was being converted to uppercase, but the expected format is lowercase.
fix: The fix is to use lowercase for the password reset file content. A commit was made to make the file content uppercase, which is more expectable, but the immediate workaround is to write the serial in lowercase.
evidence_quote: it should work. It's in lowercase
